correctness.rationale: For a vertex in part V_i the closed-neighborhood sum is exactly W-sigma_i+f(v), so checking the minimum label mu_i is necessary and sufficient for all closed-neighborhood inequalities. A -1 vertex in V_i has a 2-neighbor exactly when at least one 2 occurs outside V_i. The multinomial factor counts exactly the labelings with each valid profile. Exhaustive replay through order 9 agrees with the literal graph definition for 748341 labelings and with every computed weight coefficient.

originality.rationale: The founding work provides bounds, the complete-bipartite paper provides exact scalar minima, and the 2017 Yin--Chen paper is bibliographically identified as determining the signed Roman domination number of complete multipartite graphs. The retained claim excludes that scalar minimum and instead gives an all-function profile classification and full weight enumerator. Four focused semantic searches returned no matching published all-function result. The inaccessible Yin--Chen full text is retained as a concrete residual risk rather than treated as negative evidence.

value.rationale: The full weight distribution is a natural strengthening of a domination number: it counts every feasible signed Roman assignment at every weight, permits enumeration of minimum and nonminimum solutions, and exposes how the distribution depends on arbitrary part sizes. It is a complete classification for a standard graph class, not an arbitrary finite slice or a recomputation of a known table.
